themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents designed to perform complex research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including planning, tool use, and iterative problem-solving within research contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, acting as a pair programmer or intelligent assistant.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles detailing AI's capability to condense large amounts of text, such as research papers, meeting transcripts, or articles, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools and platforms designed to enhance or automate various stages of the research process.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the use, impact, and development of AI chatbots specifically within the context of research, user interaction, and information gathering.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on the application of AI in the design process, from ideation and concept generation to UI/UX design and prototyping.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of simulated user profiles or 'digital twins' for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Examines how AI is being used and studied within the recruitment and hiring process, including bias, efficiency, and job displacement.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's role in creating, distributing, analyzing, and optimizing surveys and feedback mechanisms.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's application in automating testing processes, including software testing, usability testing, and accessibility testing.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
